written: 2026-10-20, after the catalogue gained Saylor Academy courses and before any run on these profiles; the first set's results (5 of 12) were known, its profiles were not reused
author: AIVANCIN builder (Claude Code; model reported by the client: Claude Opus 5.5). Synthetic, agent-written English
labelling_rule: True activities chosen by meaning from keyword searches of the O*NET 31.0 activity names; no model or BM25 scores consulted
confirmation: Strict simulated confirmation: a suggested activity is ticked only if it is in the profile's true set; guard-flagged suggestions are never ticked; other-work lane
pass_rule: A profile passes when it receives at least two relevant routes (route role in the profile family's SOC list), each with at least one sourced requirement and a first four-week block that serves at least three prioritized gaps with verified resources within 4 x weekly hours of effort and the budget. Target: at least 80% of in-scope profiles. Out-of-scope profiles are reported separately. The pre-revision build is measured first on the same profiles, counting its top three roles and their plans the same way

in_scope.name: Farid
in_scope.other_work: I run the computers and the wifi at my uncle's tuition centre. I replace broken keyboards, screens and hard drives when they fail. When a teacher cannot print or log in, I sit with them until it works. I install the antivirus and the updates on every machine each month. I write down every fault and fix in a shared spreadsheet.

in_scope.name: Mei Ling
in_scope.other_work: At the call centre I am the one colleagues ask when their headsets or software freeze. I reset their passwords and unlock their accounts in the admin tool. I test new versions of our ticketing app before they go live and report the bugs. I train new staff to use the system. I keep a guide of common fixes on our team page.

in_scope.name: Kumar
in_scope.other_work: I set up the network at my church: the router, two switches and the wireless access points. I run cables through the ceiling and test each one. When the internet slows down I check which devices use the most bandwidth. I keep a diagram of where every cable and device goes.

in_scope.name: Aisyah
in_scope.other_work: I manage the laptops and phones for my mother's small travel agency. I set up email, file sharing and backups for the five staff. I make sure everyone uses strong passwords and two-step login. When a laptop is too slow I compare models, order a new one and set it up. I answer their computer questions over WhatsApp.

in_scope.name: Hakim
in_scope.other_work: I build Android apps in Kotlin for small shops in my area. I design the screens with the owners and change them after they try the app. I connect each app to a database of the shop's products and prices. I fix crashes that users report. I publish updates every few weeks.

in_scope.name: Siti
in_scope.other_work: I write Python scripts that automate the weekly reports at my office. I clean the data from our three branches so the columns match. I keep my scripts in a GitHub repository with notes on how to run them. I test each script on last month's data before anyone uses it.

in_scope.name: Daniel
in_scope.other_work: I make websites for local events with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I make sure the pages load fast and work on phones. I check that the sites can be used with a screen reader. I set up the hosting and the domain names. I fix layout bugs that people send me.

in_scope.name: Nurul
in_scope.other_work: I test games for an indie studio run by my friends. I play each new build and record every bug with the steps to reproduce it. I write simple test cases in a spreadsheet and tick them off for each release. I check that fixed bugs stay fixed in the next build.

in_scope.name: Rina
in_scope.other_work: I keep the accounts for my father's hardware shop. I record every sale and purchase and reconcile the bank statement each month. I prepare the yearly figures for the tax agent. I check supplier invoices against the delivery orders before we pay.

in_scope.name: Arif
in_scope.other_work: I am treasurer of our residents' association. I prepare the yearly budget and track spending against it every month. I present the accounts at the annual meeting and answer questions about them. I compare quotes from contractors and recommend the best value.

in_scope.name: Grace
in_scope.other_work: I build sales reports in Excel and Power BI for the online shop where I pack orders. I pull the order data every week and remove duplicate customers. I make charts that show which products sell best in each state. I send the owner a short summary of what changed.

in_scope.name: Jason
in_scope.other_work: I help my cousin's car-loan agency check new applicants. I go through their payslips and bank statements and work out how much they can repay. I enter each case into a spreadsheet that scores the risk. I explain the loan terms to customers who are unsure.

out_of_scope.name: Hana
out_of_scope.other_work: I take water samples from the river for a conservation group. I test them for pH and bacteria in a small lab. I record the results and send them to the state office.

out_of_scope.name: Ravi
out_of_scope.other_work: I organise weekend hiking trips for tourists. I plan the routes and book the transport. I teach first-timers how to pack and stay safe.

out_of_scope.name: Lina
out_of_scope.other_work: I design kitchens and wardrobes for friends' homes. I draw the plans in SketchUp and pick the materials. I check the measurements on site before the carpenter starts.
